mapper.update: UPDATE blog SET title = #{title}, cate_id = #{cateId}, cate_name = #{cateName}, cover_img = #{coverImg}, content = #{content}, state = #{state}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog (id, title, cate_id, cate_name, cover_img, content, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{cateId}, #{cateName}, #{coverImg}, #{content}, #{state}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, cate_id, cate_name, cover_img, content, state, create_time, update_time FROM blog ORDER BY create_time DESC
